title: India’s First 5.56 km Free‑Space Quantum Key Distribution Link Demonstrated
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                03 OCT 2026 4:44PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: QNu Labs, BISAG-N, and IIT Gandhinagar successfully demonstrated India's first 5.56 km free-space Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) link.
Achieved a stable Quantum Bit Error Rate (QBER) below 5% and a secure key generation rate of 230–260 bps.
Integrated QNu Labs' hardware QKD device ('Armos') over free-space optical channels with BISAG-N's software-based post-quantum cryptography platform ('Vedic Kavach').
Provides a foundational architecture for quantum-resilient communications, satellite quantum security, and national secure digital infrastructure.

title: TDB-DST signs agreement with QNu Labs for ₹150 crore RDI support to strengthen India’s indigenous quantum-secure technology ecosystem
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                16 OCT 2026 2:50PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: Technology Development Board (TDB-DST) has signed an agreement with QNu Labs for ₹150 crore financial support under the Research Development and Innovation (RDI) Fund for a ₹300-crore project.
The initiative aims to build an indigenous technology backbone for India's Quantum Secure and Sensing Networks (IQSN), moving technologies from TRL 4-5 to TRL-9.

The framework rests on four pillars: Identity Security (quantum-secure PUFs and quantum-safe TPMs), Location Integrity (quantum magnetometers for GPS-denied navigation), Network Security (chip-based and satellite-based Quantum Key Distribution), and Time Integrity (atomic clock infrastructure and QKD-authenticated time synchronization).

title: Pumped Storage Hydropower
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                19 OCT 2026 11:02AM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: Pumped Storage Hydropower (PSP) acts as a 'water battery' providing long-duration energy storage and grid stability essential for integrating variable renewable energy.

India's Clean Energy Target: India reached over 300 GW installed non-fossil fuel capacity by July 2026, targeting 500 GW by 2030; CEA projects 73.93 GW of total storage capacity (26.69 GW PSP + 47.24 GW BESS) needed by 2031–32.

Types of PSPs: Categorised into On-stream (both reservoirs on natural watercourse), Off-stream Open-loop (one reservoir on natural watercourse), and Off-stream Closed-loop (neither reservoir on natural watercourse).

National Potential & Capacity: India has identified 345.38 GW potential across 320 PSP sites (highest in Western Region at 129.72 GW); operational capacity stands at 7.43 GW across 10 projects as of August 2026.

Regulatory Framework & Facilitation: Measures include April 2023 Dedicated Guidelines, 25-year 100% ISTS charge waiver for projects awarded by June 2028, faster CEA DPR concurrence (reduced to 50 days), raising the CEA capex approval threshold to ₹3,000 crore, and completely exempting off-stream closed-loop PSPs from CEA concurrence.
